reviews.title: Great use for Home RIAD 5 NAS
reviews.comment: Has 4 power sata 3 necessary to build a RAID 5 NAS. Used Open Media Vault, PLEX, to create my NAS/Plex server.
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.title: Defective item!
reviews.comment: We received the motherboard and installed it but would not work... After a lot of back and forth we finally narrowed it down to this motherboard and after checking carefully we found that some of the connector pins were bent! Tried to get a replacement or refund but Amazon say no 😑 Disappointed to say the least!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: DOA Unresponsive
reviews.comment: The unit I received had some apparent pin damage. It appears to be DOA because the system wouldn't even begin to boot. I tried multiple different power supply units and different hardware configurations but this motherboard was completely unresponsive. However, it was simple enough to install and nice that it came with 4:3 pin system fan adapters
reviews.author: Seth M
